text:
Amir - People Ops: Heads-up: today were expanding Civic Leave and Jury Duty policy. Key changes: paid jury duty up to 20 business days (was 10), 3 days paid civic volunteering leave per year, and an expedited make-whole payroll process for jury summons that overlap pay dates. Full policy + FAQ: https://redwoodintra.company/policies/civic-jury-update

Selina - People Ops: TL;DR for managers: 1) Use Workday > Time Off > Civic Leave (subtype: Jury or Volunteering) for approvals; 2) For jury duty, employees should upload the summons but we accept provisional approvals for urgent schedules; 3) Managers can approve provisional pay and People Ops will reconcile.

Jon: Nice. Quick Q: what does "make-whole payroll" mean in practice?

Amir - People Ops: Good Q  if an employee misses a payroll cutoff due to jury service, Payroll will process a one-off 'make-whole' payment outside the regular cycle so pay isn't delayed. It shows as "Jury Make-Whole" on the stub. We included timing examples in the doc.

Priya: Are the 3 days of civic volunteering separate from PTO? And can they be used for community jury-related civic prep (like paperwork)?

Selina - People Ops: Yes, volunteering days are separate and do NOT affect your PTO. They can be used for eligible civic activities like community volunteering, voter assistance, or civic prep time tied to jury participation (we have a short list in the policy). If in doubt, flag the request as "Civic-Prep" and People Ops will confirm.

Jon: International employees? Does this apply globally? Jury systems differ a lot.

Amir - People Ops: Policy applies to US employees by default. For EMEA/APAC we added country-specific guidance: where local law provides civic leave, Redwood will match or exceed statutory minimums. If local law doesn't cover it, we offer a baseline of 5 paid jury-equivalent days pending legal review. See the international appendix in the doc. If you have a specific country case, DM people-ops and well advise.

Priya: Any verification required? Some employees worry about sharing summons PDFs.

Selina - People Ops: We accept a redacted copy with non-essential personal info masked. For provisional approvals, managers can approve without docs and People Ops will request the redacted summons within 10 business days. All docs are handled per privacy policy.

HR-Bot: Policy PDF uploaded: https://redwoodintra.company/policies/civic-jury-update.pdf. Manager quick-guide attached.

Amir - People Ops: Were running a 20-min manager briefing tomorrow 4:00pm PT to walk through the new flows and examples. RSVP in the doc. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
